buffmobs.command.presets.entry: Preset %s (%s): HP %sx, DMG %sx, SPD %sx, ASPD %sx, Armor +%s, Toughness +%s
buffmobs.command.reset.adaptive.done: Adaptive difficulty counters reset. Buffs reapplied to %s mobs.
buffmobs.command.reset.all.done: BuffMobs progression fully reset: scaling back to day 0, adaptive counters cleared, Blood Moon cycle restarted. %s mobs reinitialized.
buffmobs.command.reset.bloodmoon.done: Blood Moon cycle reset. Buffs reapplied to %s mobs.
buffmobs.command.reset.confirm_required: This reset is destructive. Run the command again with 'confirm' at the end to proceed.
buffmobs.command.reset.mobs.done: Mob caches cleared. %s mobs reinitialized from scratch.
buffmobs.command.reset.scaling.done: Day scaling reset to day 0 (world time unchanged). Buffs reapplied to %s mobs.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.bonus: Multiplier bonus added per death step. 0.1 = +10%.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.death: Player deaths required for each adaptive bonus step.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.enabl: The effective multiplier reacts to player performance: player deaths raise it, buffed mob kills can lower it. It is multiplied on top of day scaling and the counters are saved per world.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.killR: Reduce the adaptive bonus as players kill buffed mobs, indicating they are comfortable.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.kills: Buffed mob kills by players required for each reduction step.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.maxBo: Maximum accumulated adaptive bonus. 2.0 = up to +200% (3x total) on top of day scaling.
buffmobs.config.adaptiveDifficulty.reduc: Multiplier bonus removed per kill step. The adaptive bonus never drops below zero.
buffmobs.config.attributes.armorAddition: Flat armor points added to mobs. 20 = full diamond armor equivalent.
buffmobs.config.attributes.armorToughnes: Flat armor toughness added to mobs. Reduces the effectiveness of high-damage hits.
buffmobs.config.attributes.attackSpeedMu: Multiplies the base attack speed of mobs.
buffmobs.config.attributes.damageMultipl: Multiplies the base attack damage of all buffed mobs. 1.5 = 50% more damage.
buffmobs.config.attributes.healthMultipl: Multiplies the base max health of all buffed mobs. 1.5 = 50% more HP.
buffmobs.config.attributes.speedMultipli: Multiplies movement speed. No upper cap — use carefully.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.doubleLootAndX: Double scaled XP and extra loot rolls during a Blood Moon. Requires Loot & XP Scaling to be enabled.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.enabled.toolti: Every few days a Blood Moon night makes buffed mobs stronger. The event is purely logical: world time is never changed, and the cycle is saved per world.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.extraMultiplie: Extra multiplier applied on top of normal scaling while a Blood Moon is active.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.extraSpawnChan: Chance that a natural spawn during a Blood Moon is duplicated once.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.glowingMobs.to: Apply a temporary Glowing effect to buffed mobs during a Blood Moon so they stand out.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.intervalDays.t: In-game days between Blood Moon nights.
Send a global chat notification to all players when a Blood Moon starts and ends.
buffmobs.config.bloodMoon.spawnBoostEnab: Approximates a higher spawn rate by occasionally duplicating natural spawns during a Blood Moon. Changing the true vanilla spawn rate is not supported.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.cooldownTick: Ticks between uses of the potion per mob. 600 = 30 seconds.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.enabled.tool: When enabled, hostile and neutral mobs drink a regeneration potion when they fall below the health threshold.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.healthThresh: Fraction of max HP at which the potion is triggered. 0.20 = triggers below 20% HP.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.maxUses.tool: Maximum number of times a mob can use the potion per life. 0 = no limit.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.regenAmplifi: Level of the Regeneration effect applied. Undead mobs receive Absorption + direct heal instead.
buffmobs.config.combatDraft.regenDuratio: How long the regeneration effect lasts in seconds.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.enabled.toolt: Progressively increases mob strength as in-game days pass. No upper cap.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.interval.tool: Number of in-game days between each difficulty increase.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.maxMultiplier: Maximum multiplier day scaling can reach. Set to 0 for unlimited.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.multiplier.to: How much the multiplier increases per interval. 0.1 = +10% per interval. No upper cap.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.notificationM: When to send day scaling notifications to players.
buffmobs.config.dayScaling.showNotificat: Show a chat message to all players when the difficulty increases.
buffmobs.config.dimensionFilter.blacklis: Dimensions where mobs will never be buffed. Format: minecraft:the_nether
buffmobs.config.dimensionFilter.useWhite: If true, mobs are only buffed in dimensions listed in the Allowlist.
buffmobs.config.dimensionFilter.whitelis: Dimensions where mobs are buffed when Use Allowlist is enabled.
buffmobs.config.dimensionMaxHealth.allow: Mob IDs eligible for dimension max health overrides (used when useAllowlist = true).
buffmobs.config.dimensionMaxHealth.denyl: Mob IDs that never receive dimension max health overrides.
buffmobs.config.dimensionMaxHealth.enabl: Enable fixed max health overrides per dimension.
buffmobs.config.dimensionMaxHealth.maxHe: Fixed max health applied to mobs in this dimension (0 = disabled).
buffmobs.config.dimensionMaxHealth.useAl: If true, only mobs in 'allowlist' receive dimension max health overrides.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.armorAd: Flat armor points added to mobs in this dimension.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.attackS: Attack speed multiplier for this dimension as a percentage.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.damageP: Damage multiplier for this dimension as a percentage.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.dimensi: The dimension ID to apply scaling to. Example: minecraft:the_nether
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.healthP: Health multiplier for this dimension as a percentage. 200 = double HP.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.mode.to: SCALING: multiplies base attributes by dimension multipliers. OVERRIDE: replaces base attributes with dimension multipliers (global and preset multipliers are ignored).
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.speedPe: Speed multiplier for this dimension as a percentage.
buffmobs.config.dimensionScaling.toughne: Flat armor toughness added to mobs in this dimension.
buffmobs.config.effects.absorptionAmplif: Absorption effect level granted to mobs. 0 = disabled.
buffmobs.config.effects.duration.tooltip: Duration of status effects in seconds. Use -1 for infinite (refreshed every second).
buffmobs.config.effects.regenerationAmpl: Regeneration effect level granted to mobs. 0 = disabled. Skipped for undead mobs.
buffmobs.config.effects.resistanceAmplif: Resistance effect level granted to mobs. 0 = disabled.
buffmobs.config.effects.speedAmplifier.t: Speed effect level granted to mobs. 0 = disabled.
buffmobs.config.effects.strengthAmplifie: Strength effect level granted to mobs. 0 = disabled.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.baseChance.too: Base chance for a buffed mob to become Elite on spawn. 0.02 = 2%.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.bonusRewardsEn: Enable bonus XP and extra loot rolls for killing Elite mobs. Works even when Loot & XP Scaling is disabled.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.chanceIncrease: Additional Elite chance gained per in-game day.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.customNameColo: Hex RGB color used when Elite Name Color is CUSTOM. Examples: #FF55FF, FF55FF or 0xFF55FF. Invalid values fall back to gold.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.damageMultipli: Damage multiplier applied to Elite mobs on top of normal buffs.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.enabled.toolti: Buffed mobs have a chance to spawn as stronger Elite variants with a custom name and particles. Never applies to tamed or blacklisted mobs. Elites are re-rolled when a mob is saved and loaded again.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.generatedNameP: Words randomly placed before the mob name in Generated mode. The default entries are language keys, so Elite names appear in each player's language. Custom text without dots is shown exactly as written.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.generatedNameS: Titles randomly placed after the mob name in Generated mode. The default entries are language keys, so Elite names appear in each player's language. Custom text without dots is shown exactly as written.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.healthMultipli: Health multiplier applied to Elite mobs on top of normal buffs.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.nameColor.tool: Color used for the Elite custom name. RANDOM picks one preset color for each Elite mob; CUSTOM uses the custom color below.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.nameMode.toolt: Generated builds a roguelike name from the prefix and suffix lists around the mob type name, e.g. 'Grim Zombie, the Undying'. Translatable Prefix uses the Name Prefix option above, e.g. 'Elite Zombie'.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.namePrefix.too: Translatable prefix shown before the Elite mob name. Random picks one prefix per mob.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.notifyNearbyPl: Send a chat message to players within the notify radius when an Elite mob spawns.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.notifyRadius.t: Radius in blocks used for Elite notifications. If no player is nearby when the Elite spawns, the notification is sent when a player first comes within this radius.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.particle.toolt: Vanilla particle continuously shown around Elite mobs. Random: each Elite gets its own randomly picked particle and keeps it.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.rewardExtraLoo: Extra loot table rolls granted when an Elite mob dies, added on top of any Loot & XP Scaling rolls.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.rewardXpMultip: XP multiplier applied when an Elite mob dies (5.0 = five times the normal XP), stacked on top of any Loot & XP Scaling bonus.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.useGeneratedPr: Add a random word from the Generated Name Prefixes list before the mob name.
buffmobs.config.eliteMobs.useGeneratedSu: Add a random title from the Generated Name Suffixes list after the mob name.
buffmobs.config.filter.blacklist.tooltip: List of IDs that are always excluded. Format: modid:entry_id
buffmobs.config.filter.useWhitelist.tool: If enabled, only entries listed in the Allowlist are affected. The Denylist is ignored when this is on.
buffmobs.config.filter.whitelist.tooltip: List of IDs that are exclusively affected when Use Allowlist is enabled.
buffmobs.config.general.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable the mod entirely. When disabled, all mobs lose their buffs.
buffmobs.config.general.visualEffects.to: Show particle effects on mobs that have status effects applied.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.chance.to: Probability of a harmful effect being applied on each hit. 0.15 = 15% chance.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.enabled.t: When enabled, buffed mobs have a chance to apply a random harmful effect (Poison, Slowness or Wither, each toggleable below) to the player on hit.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.poisonDur: How long the Poison effect lasts on the player, in seconds.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.poisonEna: Allow Poison to be randomly picked when a buffed mob applies a harmful effect on hit. This Harmful Effects category is where the random Poison, Slowness and Wither debuffs come from.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.slownessD: How long the Slowness effect lasts on the player, in seconds.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.slownessE: Allow Slowness to be randomly picked when a buffed mob applies a harmful effect on hit.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.witherDur: How long the Wither effect lasts on the player, in seconds.
buffmobs.config.harmfulEffects.witherEna: Allow Wither to be randomly picked when a buffed mob applies a harmful effect on hit.
buffmobs.config.healthSync.enabled.toolt: Synchronize a mob's current health with its new max health after BuffMobs modifies it.
buffmobs.config.healthSync.mode.tooltip: OVERRIDE fully heals the mob. STACK preserves the damage already taken and adds the health delta on top.
buffmobs.config.lootXpScaling.enabled.to: Buffed mobs drop more XP and can roll their loot table extra times based on their effective buff multiplier (base attributes, dimension, preset, day and adaptive scaling). Mobs filtered out by the mob/dimension filters never scale loot.
buffmobs.config.lootXpScaling.extraLootR: Roll the mob loot table additional times based on its effective buff multiplier, instead of multiplying existing drops.
buffmobs.config.lootXpScaling.maxExtraLo: Maximum number of extra loot rolls per mob. Extra rolls grow with the effective buff multiplier and are doubled during a Blood Moon (cap is doubled as well).
buffmobs.config.lootXpScaling.maxXpMulti: Maximum XP multiplier from effective buff scaling. During a Blood Moon the final XP is doubled after this cap.
buffmobs.config.lootXpScaling.xpScalingE: Scale dropped XP in proportion to the mob's effective buff multiplier (base attributes, dimension, preset, day and adaptive scaling), not the day multiplier alone.
buffmobs.config.menu.reset.tooltip: Reset this option to its default value
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.additionalArmor: Additional mob IDs (e.g. from other mods) treated as having valid armor slots. Zombies, skeletons and piglins (and their variants) are always eligible.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.aquaAffinityMax: Maximum level of Aqua Affinity that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.aquaAffinityUnl: Day on which Aqua Affinity becomes available on mob armor. Helmets only.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.bindingCurseEna: Allow Curse of Binding on generated armor. It mainly matters if the piece can drop and a player equips it.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.blastProtection: Maximum level of Blast Protection that can be applied.
Day on which Blast Protection becomes available on mob armor. It cannot be combined with another protection type on the same piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.bootsChance.too: Chance to include boots in Random Pieces mode. 1.0 = always; 0.0 = never unless needed to reach the minimum piece count.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.chestplateChanc: Chance to include a chestplate in Random Pieces mode. 1.0 = always; 0.0 = never unless needed to reach the minimum piece count.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.curseChance.too: Chance for each enabled curse to be applied to each generated armor piece.
Day on which curses become available on generated mob armor.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.cursesEnabled.t: Allow curse enchantments on generated armor pieces.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.daysPerEnchantm: How many in-game days must pass after unlocking for each armor enchantment to gain one level.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.depthStriderMax: Maximum level of Depth Strider that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.depthStriderUnl: Day on which Depth Strider becomes available on mob armor. Boots only, and it cannot be combined with Frost Walker on the same piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.diamondUnlockDa: Day on which diamond armor becomes available.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.diamondWeight.t: Selection weight of the diamond tier once unlocked.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.dropChance.tool: Drop chance for each generated armor piece when generated armor drops are enabled. Vanilla equipment uses about 0.085 before looting bonuses.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.dropChanceEnabl: Allow armor generated by BuffMobs to drop when the mob dies. When off, generated armor never drops.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.enabled.tooltip: Buffed mobs with valid armor slots spawn wearing a generated armor setup that scales with day and dimension. Generated armor drops only when generated armor drops are enabled.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.enchantedPieceC: Chance for each individual generated armor piece to receive enchantments. 1.0 = every piece can roll enchantments.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.enchantmentsEna: Whether generated armor pieces can receive enchantments.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.equipChance.too: Chance that an eligible buffed mob receives a generated armor setup. 1.0 = always.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.featherFallingM: Maximum level of Feather Falling that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.featherFallingU: Day on which Feather Falling becomes available on mob boots.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.fireProtectionM: Maximum level of Fire Protection that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.fireProtectionU: Day on which Fire Protection becomes available on mob armor. It cannot be combined with another protection type on the same piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.frostWalkerMaxL: Maximum level of Frost Walker that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.frostWalkerUnlo: Day on which Frost Walker becomes available on mob armor. Boots only, and it cannot be combined with Depth Strider on the same piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.goldUnlockDay.t: Day on which golden armor becomes available.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.goldWeight.tool: Selection weight of the golden tier once unlocked.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.helmetChance.to: Chance to include a helmet in Random Pieces mode. 1.0 = always; 0.0 = never unless needed to reach the minimum piece count.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.ironUnlockDay.t: Day on which iron armor becomes available.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.ironWeight.tool: Selection weight of the iron tier once unlocked.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.leatherUnlockDa: Day on which leather armor becomes available.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.leatherWeight.t: Selection weight of the leather tier once unlocked. Gold is more common in the Nether; diamond and netherite are more common in the End.
Chance to include leggings in Random Pieces mode. 1.0 = always; 0.0 = never unless needed to reach the minimum piece count.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.maxEnchantments: Maximum number of enchantments on a single armor piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.maxPieces.toolt: Maximum pieces allowed in Random Pieces mode. Extra selected slots are removed randomly. Values below the minimum are treated as the minimum.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.minPieces.toolt: Minimum pieces guaranteed in Random Pieces mode. Missing slots are filled randomly until this count is reached.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.mixedTiersEnabl: Roll the armor tier separately for each equipped piece, creating mixed setups instead of one matching tier for the whole mob.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.netheriteUnlock: Day on which netherite armor becomes available.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.netheriteWeight: Selection weight of the netherite tier once unlocked.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.projectileProte: Maximum level of Projectile Protection that can be applied.
Day on which Projectile Protection becomes available on mob armor. It cannot be combined with another protection type on the same piece.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.protectionMaxLe: Maximum level of Protection that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.protectionUnloc: Day on which Protection becomes available on mob armor.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.respirationMaxL: Maximum level of Respiration that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.respirationUnlo: Day on which Respiration becomes available on mob armor. Helmets only.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.setupMode.toolt: FULL_SET equips every armor slot. RANDOM_PIECES rolls each slot with the chances below, then enforces the minimum and maximum piece counts.
Maximum level of Thorns that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.thornsUnlockDay: Day on which Thorns becomes available on mob armor.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.unbreakingMaxLe: Maximum level of Unbreaking that can be applied.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.unbreakingUnloc: Day on which Unbreaking becomes available on mob armor.
buffmobs.config.mobArmor.vanishingCurseE: Allow Curse of Vanishing on generated armor. A vanishing piece disappears when the mob dies even if generated armor drops are enabled.
buffmobs.config.mobFilter.blacklist.tool: Mob IDs that will never be buffed. Format: minecraft:zombie
buffmobs.config.mobFilter.useWhitelist.t: If true, only mobs listed in the Allowlist will be buffed.
buffmobs.config.mobFilter.whitelist.tool: Mob IDs that will be buffed when included in the Allowlist.
buffmobs.config.mobPresets.enabled.toolt: When enabled, individual mobs can be assigned a preset that overrides the global multipliers.
buffmobs.config.mobPresets.mobMapping.to: Maps mob IDs to preset names. Format: modid:mob_id:preset_name
buffmobs.config.mobPresets.overrideDimen: If true, mobs that have a matching preset ignore dimension scaling multipliers and only use the preset values.
buffmobs.config.mobPresets.presetName.to: Internal name for this preset, used in the Mob Mapping list below. Leave Preset 1 empty to use the built-in name default and Preset 2 empty to use boss; the menu still shows only Preset 1 / Preset 2. A name you type appears in the menu after you go back.
buffmobs.config.modidFilter.blacklist.to: Mod IDs whose mobs will never be buffed.
buffmobs.config.modidFilter.useWhitelist: If true, only mobs from mods in the Allowlist will be buffed.
buffmobs.config.modidFilter.whitelist.to: Mod IDs whose mobs will be buffed when Use Allowlist is enabled.
buffmobs.config.packAggression.cooldownT: Per-mob cooldown in ticks before it can be pulled by another pack attack. 200 = 10 seconds.
buffmobs.config.packAggression.enabled.t: When a buffed mob is attacked by a player, nearby mobs of the same type also target that player. Tamed and filtered-out mobs are ignored.
buffmobs.config.packAggression.maxPackSi: Maximum number of additional mobs pulled per attack.
buffmobs.config.packAggression.radius.to: Radius in blocks searched for pack members of the same type.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.bas: Base attack damage dealt by converted passive mobs before the same BuffMobs damage multipliers used by hostile mobs.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.bla: Mob IDs that will never be made aggressive even when Passive Aggression is enabled.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.hea: Controls how strongly the mob's HP% affects damage. Formula: baseDamage + (HP% * factor * maxHP). 0.1 = 10% of max HP added at full health.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.mod: OFF: passive mobs behave normally. NEUTRAL: they attack back when hit. HOSTILE: they actively attack players on sight. Converted passive mobs also receive the same BuffMobs scaling, effects, equipment and feature eligibility as hostile mobs.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.sca: When enabled, converted passive mob damage also grows from the mob's base max HP before normal BuffMobs damage multipliers.
buffmobs.config.passiveMobAggression.whi: If non-empty, only these mob IDs will be made aggressive. Format: minecraft:cow
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.beh: How ranged mobs choose their combat style. Melee = always switch, Kite = always flee, Random = decided on spawn.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.cus: Additional mob IDs that should be treated as ranged mobs for switching behavior.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.day: How many in-game days must pass for each enchantment to gain one level.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.ena: Enables ranged mobs to change behavior when the player gets close.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.enc: Whether melee weapons given to ranged mobs can have enchantments.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.fir: Maximum level of Fire Aspect that can be applied.
Day on which Fire Aspect becomes available on melee weapons.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.kno: Maximum level of Knockback that can be applied.
Day on which Knockback becomes available on melee weapons.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.max: Maximum number of enchantments that can be applied to a single melee weapon.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.mel: Speed boost applied when a mob enters melee mode. 1.2 = 20% faster.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.sha: Maximum level of Sharpness that can be applied.
Day on which Sharpness becomes available on melee weapons.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.swe: Maximum level of Sweeping Edge that can be applied.
Day on which Sweeping Edge becomes available on melee weapons.
buffmobs.config.rangedMeleeSwitching.swi: Distance in blocks at which a ranged mob switches behavior.
Ticks between minion summons while the ability is active. 200 = 10 seconds.
Maximum number of simultaneously alive minions per summoner. 0 disables summoning.
Entity ID summoned as a minion, e.g. minecraft:zombie.
Only Summon minions while the mob has an attack target.
buffmobs.config.specialAbilities.Telepor: Chance to Teleport behind the attacker when damaged.
Ticks before the mob can Teleport again.
Distance in blocks behind the attacker used as the Teleport destination.
buffmobs.config.specialAbilities.deathra: Whether the Explosion mode destroys blocks.
Explosion power used by the Explosion mode. 4.0 is roughly a charged creeper.
Entity ID summoned by the Summon Minions mode, e.g. minecraft:slime.
Maximum minions summoned by the Summon Minions mode.
Minimum minions summoned by the Summon Minions mode.
Effect triggered when a mob with Deathrattle dies. RANDOM chooses explosion, poison cloud or minions separately for each death.
Duration in seconds of the poison area effect cloud.
Poison level applied by the cloud.
Radius of the poison area effect cloud left on death.
buffmobs.config.specialAbilities.enabled: Assign special abilities to specific mob types using the mapping below. Everything reuses vanilla entities.
buffmobs.config.specialAbilities.lastSta: HP fraction below which Last Stand triggers once per life. 0.20 = 20% of max HP.
Resistance duration in seconds granted by Last Stand.
Resistance level granted by Last Stand.
buffmobs.config.specialAbilities.mobAbil: Maps mob IDs to ability IDs. Format: modid:mob_id:ability_id. Ability IDs: deathrattle, laststand, Teleport, Summon. Example: minecraft:zombie:laststand
buffmobs.config.title: BuffMobs Configuration
buffmobs.config.traits.armoredArmorBonus: Permanent armor points granted by the Armored trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.armoredParticle.t: Continuous particle shown by mobs with the Armored trait. None disables it. Random: each mob gets its own randomly picked particle.
buffmobs.config.traits.armoredToughnessB: Permanent armor toughness granted by the Armored trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.armoredWeight.too: Selection weight of the Armored trait: permanent armor bonus and no special particle.
buffmobs.config.traits.chance.tooltip: Chance for a buffed mob to receive exactly one trait on spawn. 0.15 = 15%.
buffmobs.config.traits.enabled.tooltip: Buffed mobs can spawn with exactly one elemental trait: an on-hit effect, a continuous particle and a passive resistance. Traits are lost on death and can coexist with Elite.
Seconds the Flame trait sets its target on fire.
buffmobs.config.traits.flameParticle.too: Continuous particle shown by mobs with the Flame trait. None disables it. Random: each mob gets its own randomly picked particle.
buffmobs.config.traits.flameWeight.toolt: Selection weight of the Flame trait: ignites targets on hit and is immune to fire damage.
buffmobs.config.traits.frostParticle.too: Continuous particle shown by mobs with the Frost trait. None disables it. Random: each mob gets its own randomly picked particle.
buffmobs.config.traits.frostSlownessLeve: Slowness level applied by the Frost trait. 2 = Slowness II.
buffmobs.config.traits.frostSlownessSeco: Seconds of Slowness applied by the Frost trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.frostWeight.toolt: Selection weight of the Frost trait: applies Slowness on hit and is immune to freeze damage.
buffmobs.config.traits.onHitEffectsEnabl: Enable trait on-hit effects: Flame ignites, Frost slows, Toxic poisons, Voltaic chains damage, Vampiric heals on hit. This is separate from the Harmful Effects category, which applies a random effect from any buffed mob.
buffmobs.config.traits.toxicParticle.too: Continuous particle shown by mobs with the Toxic trait. None disables it. Random: each mob gets its own randomly picked particle.
Poison level applied by the Toxic trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.toxicPoisonSecond: Seconds of Poison applied by the Toxic trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.toxicWeight.toolt: Selection weight of the Toxic trait: applies Poison on hit and is immune to Poison.
buffmobs.config.traits.vampiricHealPerce: Fraction of dealt damage healed by the Vampiric trait. 0.25 = 25%.
Continuous particle shown by mobs with the Vampiric trait. None disables it. Random: each mob gets its own randomly picked particle.
buffmobs.config.traits.vampiricWeight.to: Selection weight of the Vampiric trait: heals for a fraction of damage dealt and is immune to Wither.
buffmobs.config.traits.voltaicChainChanc: Chance for the Voltaic trait to chain extra electric damage on hit.
buffmobs.config.traits.voltaicChainDamag: Extra damage dealt to each chained enemy by the Voltaic trait.
buffmobs.config.traits.voltaicChainRadiu: Radius in blocks around the hit target searched for Voltaic chain targets.
buffmobs.config.traits.voltaicMaxTargets: Maximum number of chained enemies per Voltaic hit.
